			else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:spe_yuan } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_fxt_issuer } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:spe_yuan } has_modifier = has_central_bank } capital = { if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_fxt_issuer.var:zz_ef_nri_k } } } } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:spe_zloti } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_fxt_issuer } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:spe_zloti } has_modifier = has_central_bank } capital = { if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_zloti_state_1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_zloti_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_fxt_issuer.var:zz_ef_nri_k } } } } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_hannoveraner_thaler } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_fxt_issuer } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_hannoveraner_thaler } has_modifier = has_central_bank } capital = { if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_fxt_issuer.var:zz_ef_nri_k } } } } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_prussian_thaler } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_fxt_issuer } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_prussian_thaler } has_modifier = has_central_bank } capital = { if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_fxt_issuer.var:zz_ef_nri_k } } } } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_saxon_thaler } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_fxt_issuer } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:thaler_saxon_thaler } has_modifier = has_central_bank } capital = { if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_fxt_issuer.var:zz_ef_nri_k } } } } }
			set_variable = { name = zz_ef_nr_dep value = zz_ef_nr_dep_v }
			zz_ef_post = { FROM = zz_ef_bank_capital TO = zz_ef_nr_dep V = var:zz_ef_f_nr_int }
		}
		# the holders' stock is final for the week here (the interest above was its last change): one pass of
		# zz_ef_fx_liab_all, read by the deposits below and by zz_ef_fx_holders_demand_m
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_t_liab_all value = zz_ef_fx_liab_all }
		# the clearing's posting: our currency paid out less the one redeemed this week (zz_ef_clr_step), money;
		# withdrawn -- at most what the pool holds
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_nr_dep value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_f_clr_cur_out } change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_nr_dep add = var:zz_ef_f_clr_cur_out } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_f_clr_own_back } change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_nr_dep subtract = var:zz_ef_f_clr_own_back } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zz_ef_f_nr_dep < 0 }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_f_nr_dep
				value = {
					value = var:zz_ef_f_nr_dep
					min = {
						value = investment_pool
						min = 0
						multiply = -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_investment_pool = var:zz_ef_f_nr_dep
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_nr_dep value = zz_ef_nr_dep_v }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_nr_dep add = var:zz_ef_f_nr_dep }
		# the rest of the stocks' change, with no money behind it: the register follows the stocks, the pool does not --
		# «прочее» of the reconciliation (the pool less the book) shows it
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_nr_oth value = var:zz_ef_t_liab_all }
		change_variable = { name = zz_ef_f_nr_oth subtract = var:zz_ef_nr_dep }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_nr_dep value = var:zz_ef_t_liab_all }
	}
	# the holders' demand for the issuer's goods -- an export advantage by its currency held abroad
	if = {
		limit = { has_modifier = zz_ef_fx_holders_demand }
		remove_modifier = zz_ef_fx_holders_demand
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_nr_issuer = yes
			has_variable = zz_ef_nr_started
			zz_ef_fx_holders_demand_m > 0
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = zz_ef_fx_holders_demand
			multiplier = zz_ef_fx_holders_demand_m
		}
	}
}
